title: FinMentor Presents at FDIC Headquarters
excerpt: A delegation from the FinMentor Money Smart Organization—including Board Chair Angela Yang, CEO Michael Yang, COO Simon Shao, and another student leader—visited the headquarters of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) in Washington, D.C. During the visit, the delegation met with Assistant Director Ken Worthey and his colleagues to discuss the challenges of expanding FinMentor's reach and seek guidance and support for advancing financial education.
